references.text: God created mankind in his image, as male and female – this provides the overarching framework for the creation of woman from man.
Adam recognizes the woman as 'bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh,' the direct fulfillment of God taking a rib from him.
Summarizes that God created them as male and female and blessed them, pointing back to the creation account.
God caused a deep sleep (Hebrew: tardema) to fall upon Abram, the same Hebrew word used for Adam's deep sleep.
Jesus refers to the creation of man and woman and the origin of marriage, which traces back to God's original creative act.
Paul states that man was not made from woman, but woman from man – a direct reference to woman being created from man.
The psalmist describes God's intimate knowledge and forming of humanity, reflecting the close creative act where God formed woman.
Paul alludes directly to the rib event to support his theology on the mutual dependence of man and woman.
